g.text: PULSIPHER FARMS / ACCESSIBLE COACH DETAIL DEVELOPMENT
Captive pin, retained hinge and operating grip
C3.1 R0 · 19 OCT 2026 · INCHES UNLESS MARKED · PRELIMINARY — NOT FOR FABRICATION
Guide cap shown in context; hidden internal edges are retained for review.
Actual OEM spring form, including free-state elastic shaft contact.
The actual projecting pin tip must be visible and the GN1024-NI-3-E cotter
fully seated through its far-side crosshole. A green glimpse alone is
1.375 stroke; key turns into internal annular groove. No 90-degree hard stop.
Custom pin, guide and endcap are real nominal solids; threads use major-diameter mating envelopes, not literal thread helices.

C31 sector radius1.70 retains a0.221875 latch-hole ligament. The key/collar provides captivity. The removable spring cotter provides secondary axial retention. Endcap screw process remains unqualified.
OEM cotter STEP is its free spring form; installed deformation and the small engagement/tolerance margins require a physical prototype.
Two crew support and convert the empty seat; pins remain parked during movement. See mechanism note and exact verification records.
C31-M01 · CAD: build_c31.py / parts.json / canonical edges.gz
